issue_title: Robust handling of whitespace-malformed chunk encoding headers.
issue_body: Some real HTTP servers emit chunked transfer-encoding headers with trailing whitespace, for example b'123  \r\n'. h11 currently rejects this input with RemoteProtocolError, although the chunk size is otherwise valid. Make chunk header parsing tolerant of optional trailing whitespace while preserving rejection of malformed non-whitespace content.
validation_patch:
diff --git a/h11/tests/test_io.py b/h11/tests/test_io.py
--- a/h11/tests/test_io.py
+++ b/h11/tests/test_io.py
@@ -448,6 +448,13 @@
         + b'0; random="junk"; some=more; canbe=lonnnnngg\r\n\r\n',
         [Data(data=b"xxxxx"), EndOfMessage()],
     )
+
+    # Be lenient with trailing whitespace after a valid chunk size.
+    t_body_reader(
+        ChunkedReader,
+        b"5  \r\nxxxxx\r\n0\r\n\r\n",
+        [Data(data=b"xxxxx"), EndOfMessage()],
+    )
